flows.name: Homepage Navigation Links
flows.description: Verifies that primary navigation links on the homepage are functional and lead to the correct sections.
flows.expectation: The user is successfully navigated to the Blogs and About pages when clicking the respective navigation links.

flows.name: Search Functionality
flows.description: Tests the search input field to ensure it accepts input and triggers a search action.

steps.action: wait for search results container to be visible

flows.expectation: The search functionality returns relevant results or a results page when a valid query is entered.

flows.name: Newsletter Subscription Form
flows.description: Checks that the newsletter subscription form is present and interactive.
flows.expectation: The subscription form accepts an email address and triggers a submission action without crashing.

flows.name: Access Blog Post
flows.description: Verifies that a user can click on a blog post title and load the full article page.

steps.action: click link 'Comprehensive Logging and Reporting in Cypress (Part 3)'
wait for element 'article' to be visible

flows.expectation: The blog post content loads successfully after clicking the post title.

flows.name: Contact Page Accessibility
flows.description: Ensures the contact page or link is reachable from the main navigation.
flows.expectation: The contact page or contact section is rendered correctly without 404 errors.

notes: The site appears to be a static-generated blog; flows focus on navigation and basic interactivity. No auth-gated flows were identified as the site is public-facing.
